stories.title: Trezor confirms crypto-stealing implants in three wallets, releases fix
stories.summary: Cryptocurrency hardware wallet maker Trezor has confirmed that three Safe 5 devices sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis contained malicious hardware implants designed to steal wallet recovery phrases and send them to attackers over cellular networks. [...]

stories.title: Cisco Informational for Emergency Distrust of eMudhra Root and Intermediate Certificate Authorities
stories.summary:
Between October 17 and October 20, 2026, a critical security compromise involving Certificate Authorities that are managed by eMudhra was uncovered.

A security researcher demonstrated that the private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate certificates were fundamentally broken due to an unprecedented error in their Key Generation Ceremony (KGC) in April 2025. This allows anyone to brute-force acquire these private keys within seconds. For more information, see

stories.title: Vulnerabilities in Node.js and Brotli Affecting Cisco Products: October 2026
stories.summary:
On October 21, 2026, Node.js announced the availability of fixes for multiple vulnerabilities across the following supported release lines: 22.x, 24.x, and 26.x. 

These vulnerabilities impact critical operations such as the Brotli decoder, DNS resolution, and TLS certificate validation. The vulnerabilities pose risks for remote code execution and traffic interception. For more information, see

stories.summary: Azure Data Share will retire on November 12, 2029. Before that date, transition your data sharing workloads to Microsoft Fabric, which offers External data sharing, Cross tenant delegated shortcuts and IQ share or an appropriate data-source-specific shari
